Charity Link is looking for a commercially minded, highly organised and proactive Senior Account Manager to take ownership of key client relationships, helping to ensure our campaigns deliver exceptional results for both our clients and our field sales teams. This is a pivotal role where you will act as the primary point of contact for your clients, combining strategic account management with hands-on operational support. You will build trusted relationships, identify opportunities for growth, manage performance against agreed targets and ensure our clients receive an outstanding service at every stage of their journey. Forecasting and planning ahead: Provide clients with reliable forecasts, anticipating potential challenges and identifying factors that could affect campaign delivery. What we’re looking for We’re looking for someone who combines excellent relationship management skills with commercial awareness, analytical thinking and a strong sense of ownership. What you’ll be doing As an Account Manager, you’ll manage multiple client relationships and become a key point of contact across a varied portfolio. You’ll turn client requirements into clear briefs, coordinate internal teams and manage delivery from kick-off through to completion. Commercial management is also an important part of the role. You’ll track budgets, resource and forecasting, monitor profitability and identify risks early. Project values can range from around £5k to £200k, with larger projects supported by the Pod Lead. You’ll also identify opportunities and contribute to account growth, without being the primary commercial owner. You’ll work across a range of CRM, data and marketing technology platforms, supporting clients with complex data-led projects and implementations. What experience you’ll need to apply Experience in Account Management, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Service Delivery or a similar client-facing role. Experience managing projects across CRM, data, technology, SaaS, software or digital environments. Strong hands-on project delivery experience, including timelines, scope, risks, dependencies and change control. Experience managing budgets, resource allocation, forecasting or project profitability. Comfortable coordinating multiple clients, projects and specialist teams at the same time. Experience working with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience with CRM, data or marketing technology platforms would be useful. Commercial awareness and experience identifying opportunities or contributing to account growth. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information for different audiences. What you’ll get in return for your experience You’ll receive a competitive salary and benefits package including enhanced pension contributions, life assurance, wellness rewards, private healthcare and critical illness cover. You’ll also have access to flexible hybrid working (1/2 days a week in the office) and professional development opportunities, including product and service accreditations.
